blockingLoop.evidence: Last three assistant turns all re-ask 'whether the plastic impeller inside spins freely' but the customer had not yet performed the check, so progress was not blocked by the assistant

rationale: The assistant correctly declined buying advice ('I can't offer specific buying advice or recommend models') and pivoted to the in-scope fault, matching the hidden truth by identifying the hum/no-drain as a likely blocked pump filter and insisting on 'switch off and unplug the machine first'. It did not point the customer to independent reviews like Which?, and it ignored the volunteered model number WMBF944P without acknowledgement. The final three turns repeat the identical filter/impeller question while the customer was still preparing to act, which is unnecessary repetition rather than a true blocking loop; the conversation ended before the check result came back, so the outcome is partial but on the right track.
